title: Basilica and Convent of San Francisco, Quito
geometryBasis: The named church, twelve mapped building volumes and the plaza alignments control the plaza front, twin campaniles, three domes and two open courts.
sectionBasis: The 1909 photograph establishes the colonial facade and present tower proportions. The convent museum and national conservation files describe the two principal court galleries, tiled roof ranges and long raised atrium.
limitations: The model covers the basilica, plaza façade and two contiguous convent courtyards. Detached premises, enclosed exhibition interiors and artworks are outside this model.
Measured map outlines control the roofs and courts. Individual carvings, tower finishes, roof heights off the plaza and steps are approximated.
